BusinessHoursSettingsPanel.description: When your team is available. Displayed to customers and reserved for future SLA/ routing use.

SecuritySettingsPanel.description: Every password on the platform already requires at least {{minAllowed}} characters with a letter and a digit. Raise the minimum length further for your company here.

MessagingSettingsPanel.typingIndicatorLabel: Show agents' typing indicator to customers
MessagingSettingsPanel.description: When on, customers see a live "agent is typing…" indicator on channels that support it (Web Chat, WhatsApp, Telegram).

NotificationsSettingsPanel.description: Turn a notification type off company-wide — no agent will receive it, even if they personally enabled it in their own preferences.

AiSettingsPanel.description: Reply suggestions, summaries, translation, sentiment, and other AI features for your agents. Turn this off if your organization needs to avoid AI-generated content (e.g. for compliance reasons) — this applies even when a provider is configured below.
AiSettingsPanel.loadErrorFallback: Could not load the AI provider configuration.
AiSettingsPanel.providerCardDescription: Bring your own OpenAI, Claude, or self-hosted Ollama account for this company, instead of using the platform's shared default.
AiSettingsPanel.providerHelperText: Leave as 'Platform default' to use whatever the platform itself is configured with.
AiSettingsPanel.apiKeyHelperRequired: An API key is required for this provider.
AiSettingsPanel.apiKeyHelperAlreadySaved: A key is already saved — leave blank to keep it.
AiSettingsPanel.modelHelperText: Leave blank to use this provider's default model.
AiSettingsPanel.baseUrlHelperOllama: Your Ollama server's address, e.g. http://localhost:11434.
AiSettingsPanel.baseUrlHelperOptional: Optional — only needed for a custom/self-hosted API endpoint.
AiSettingsPanel.resourceEndpointHelperText: Your Azure OpenAI resource's endpoint, e.g. https://my-resource.openai.azure.com.
AiSettingsPanel.deploymentNameHelperText: The name you gave this model deployment in Azure OpenAI Studio.
AiSettingsPanel.apiVersionHelperText: Leave blank to use the current default API version.
AiSettingsPanel.autopilotCardDescription: Let AI handle conversations automatically in queues you've opted in (Queues & Routing → a queue's own Autopilot toggle), handing off to an agent whenever it isn't confident enough.
AiSettingsPanel.activationModesDescription: Turn on any combination. Autopilot always hands back to a human when it isn't confident enough.
AiSettingsPanel.activateOnNewConversationLabel: On a new conversation in an Autopilot queue
AiSettingsPanel.activateOnSlaLabel: When a conversation is close to missing (or has missed) its response target
AiSettingsPanel.activateOnAgentRequestLabel: Only when an agent asks AI to take over
AiSettingsPanel.noActivationModeWarning: Autopilot is enabled but has no way to start, so it will never reply. Turn on at least one option above.
AiSettingsPanel.confidenceThresholdHelperText: Below this confidence, Autopilot hands the conversation to an agent instead of replying.
AiSettingsPanel.confidenceThresholdInvalid: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

BusinessProfileSettingsPanel.description: The facts customers ask for by name. AI Autopilot may state these and nothing else about your business — anything you leave blank, it will hand to a human agent rather than guess.
BusinessProfileSettingsPanel.hoursNotice: Opening hours come from the Business Hours tab, so AI and your SLA rules always agree. Until a day is configured there, AI will not state any hours.
BusinessProfileSettingsPanel.legal_nameHelper: The trading name customers should be told. This can differ from your account name.
BusinessProfileSettingsPanel.locationHelper: Address or area customers should be given.
BusinessProfileSettingsPanel.contactHelper: Phone, email or other contact route you want AI to share.
BusinessProfileSettingsPanel.aboutHelper: A short description of what you do or sell.
